rows.name: Personal Allowance: increase to £10,600 in 2015-16 with full gains to higher rate taxpayers

conditions.measure: Personal Allowance: increase to £10,600 in 2015-16 with full gains to higher rate taxpayers
conditions.pe_expressibility_note: Reform sets the PA to GBP 10,600 for 2015-16 with the higher-rate threshold rising by the full PA increase (basic rate limit held), against the Budget 2014 baseline (GBP 10,500). The PA parameter's first key (2015-04-06: 10,600) is this measure's value, so the baseline value has to be supplied. Partial: separate age-related allowance machinery is absent (personal_allowance.py); this affects the tax change and downstream benefit response, beyond the separate dated-parameter gap.
conditions.pe_missing: No age/date-of-birth-related personal allowances or their separate income taper: personal_allowance computes one common amount and the GBP 100,000 ANI taper. Older taxpayers affected differently before 2016 cannot be represented by the common allowance reform.

rows.name: Personal Allowance: increase to £10,600 in 2015-16 with full gains to higher rate taxpayers

conditions.measure: Personal Allowance: increase to £10,600 in 2015-16 with full gains to higher rate taxpayers
conditions.pe_expressibility_note: Reform sets the PA to GBP 10,600 for 2015-16 with the higher-rate threshold rising by the full PA increase (basic rate limit held), against the Budget 2014 baseline (GBP 10,500). The PA parameter's first key (2015-04-06: 10,600) is this measure's value, so the baseline value has to be supplied. Partial: separate age-related allowance machinery is absent (personal_allowance.py); this affects the tax change and downstream benefit response, beyond the separate dated-parameter gap.
conditions.pe_missing: No age/date-of-birth-related personal allowances or their separate income taper: personal_allowance computes one common amount and the GBP 100,000 ANI taper. Older taxpayers affected differently before 2016 cannot be represented by the common allowance reform.
